item.title: Indiana Toll Road closed after crashes of 30 vehicles during snow squall
item.description: 30 vehicles were involved in a series of crashes on the Indiana Toll Road on Jan. 14, 2026, due to heavy snowfall, resulting in minor injuries and traffic diversions.

item.title: Growing number of teens charged with murder concerns prosecutor
item.description: The Marion County Prosecutor's Office filed 86 murder cases in 2025, with 30% of the cases committed by teens. Also, 66% of the people charged with murder had no prior criminal history or only nonviolent prior offenses.

item.title: Data center prompts protests in Martindale-Brightwood neighborhood
item.description: A group of faith leaders and community members protested rezoning for a $500 million data center in the Martindale-Brightwood neighborhood, citing environmental concerns and a lack of community involvement in the decision-making process.

item.title: Federal officer shoots person after attack during Minneapolis arrest
item.description: A federal officer shot a man in the leg in Minneapolis while attempting to make an arrest, resulting in clashes between federal officers and protesters, as the Trump administration continues its immigration crackdown in the state.

item.title: Woman dies after family dispute leads to shooting in Indianapolis

item.title: Tracking more snow and cold air the remainder of this week | Jan. 14, 2026
item.description: Central and northern Indiana are expecting snow accumulation of up to 1.5 inches from Thursday night into Friday, with potential for school delays and slick spots. After a short break from the snow, more snow showers are possible Saturday and Sunday.
